notes.title: Community Update!
notes.notes:
This update will see changes to most game modes. These changes are small but should have a big impact on gameplay. These updates include the following! 

1 : Most game modes now come with the gun fully loaded. This will make the action first in line over the gun itself. 

2: Glitches were the Z coin can cause you to be thrown around have been eliminated. (mostly) 

3: The game over scene has been updated so glitches are not present. I have also moved things around so you don't need to turn around when trying to go back to the main scene. 

4: Changed position of gun location in game modes were the gun is located on the player to the same position so avoid confusion. 

5: Added signs to help new players understand how the game works. 

6: Changed Game mode locate. Now you only need to find the gun This was changed from having to locate the gun and the mag and then reload. 

7: Chamber has had the gun relocated to the table so the player will not have to crouch down to pick it up from the floor every round. 

Would it be nice though to be able to turn with the thumbstick as well has have a pop of menu that you can use to close the game or exit to menu? Maybe the graphics are really bad and textures suck. Hey maybe you think its annoying that the game modes were you move around you cant climb or holster your weapon? Maybe you think the game is fun and the idea is great but does not have enough gameplay?  All these have been improved with my new game coming later this year (hopefully). These improvements can be in Zomcade. However this would make me have to remake the entire game. Yes some assets can be used but time is everything. So if you want to see Zomcade become WAY BETTER then it is now let your voice be heard! Comment! Like! or join the discord to LET ME KNOW! If people show me they want to see it I will do it and ill do it and I will do it all for free! That right! no Paid DLC. No Zomcade 2. Just one bad ass update to make this game really shine! So again LET ! ME ! KNOW! otherwise you can play my other game L.D.S or wait for my next title to be released. 



Personal blog:  Zomcade. What a bizarre adventure this one was. Zomcade was the first game I ever made. It went through so many revisions and so many issues. There were times I thought Zomcade would never see a steam release due to bugs and issues that would stop all development. Again and again this would happen but I would figure out a way to fix the issue and continue the grind. In the end of it all what was just a tech demo learning unity became a full game! It may not have Looks or played the best but it was one thing more then nothing. Once I was able to harness the confidence that I could make a game and put it on steam I then continued to create a new title based off one of my favorite Playstation one classics LSD. For everyone who gave LDS a chance I can not thank you enough. You all showed me that I can make GOOD games. As for Zomcade I really would like to make a 2.0 version. I just do not know if Zomcade is a good game or not. Not enough people played and reviewed it for me to go forward  with such a large task. So if you are reading this and played Zomcade just let me know what you liked and did not like about it. Thanks again everyone for being super rad!
